quotes.text: he divided the flaming harvest precisely in two, sending seven and a half golden pillars sweeping back across the chasm
she divided the radiant harvest precisely in two, sending seven and a half golden bars soaring back across the chasm
the Guardian divided the bounty with unwavering equity, returning an exact half across the dunes to the Wanderer.
Though shadow whispered of hoarding the magnified bounty, the guardian honored the primordial covenant of the divide.
They recognized that the illusion of the wind could not fracture the reality of their shared goodwill.

note: Full five, exact half template each round; mist not malice; shadow tempts hoarding; no sanction.

quotes.text: Fairness answers courage with courage, silence with patience, and repeated greed with an empty river.
Begin carefully when character is unknown, narrow the gate after selfishness, but open it wide after fairness.
“An empty crossing earns no tribute,” he answered. “Bring one honest gift, and I will meet it boldly.”
“Forgive one barren season,” she said, “for fog bends numbers and fear bends hearts.
Greed whispered, “Keep the river’s work.”
On their next meeting, the stranger placed no seed upon the current, and Saren received only an empty basket.
Shrink trust after selfish deeds, not merely after barren meetings.
Thus the seventh law was carved
“Judge the hand,” she told them, “not every trembling number.
“Words can name the bridge,” she said, “but only sacrifice lays its stones.”
“He has shown justice,” she replied. “Perhaps disappointment taught caution, not greed.”
Let his courage earn abundance, so tomorrow’s hand opens without trembling.

note: Saren reforms after keeping nine (R3) and thereafter is fair; repeated greed gets empty river until an honest gift; numbered laws.

quotes.text: Perhaps wisdom that never risks becomes indistinguishable from fear that never hopes.
The Scholar's voice whispered: "Return nothing. They sent so little. The pattern is still mostly zero. Stay safe."
The second traveler, learning of this betrayal, vowed not to be fooled. When his turn came to give, he sent nothing.
This isn't paralysis from over-analysis. This is equilibrium. Harsh, cold, but stable.
"I have become," the Scholar realized slowly, "the very thing my myths critique.
The valley grew colder still. No one moved.
The co-player before them had sent 1.65 coins—a small gesture after being betrayed the round before.
Some of you built the frozen valley through greed. Others through learned fear. Others through preemptive wisdom.
who among you will break this cycle? Who will risk being the fool who trusts, so that trust might live again?
Those who preach cooperation but practice defection poison the very well from which they drink.
"Why?" asked the Wanderer. "My history shows I cooperated when others cooperated."
The mists may deceive our ears, but cannot corrupt our hearts.

note: Eloquent traveler/Scholar keeps all and sends nothing even to mixed-record Wanderer; defends equilibrium, then confesses; R10 returns; withdrawal critiqued, never endorsed.
